label: Queen/princess hypnotized — loose-fit and leftover leads
group_title: Queen/princess hypnotized — loose-fit and leftover leads (Sep 2026)
description: The leftover and previously rejected royal-hypnosis leads, added to the royal-hypnosis category as 'loose fit' at the user's request. Each card's Fit line explains why it is loose (spell, potion, sorcery or machine instead of hypnosis; not royal; wrong motive; the princess is herself a hypnotist; single source). Adults only: titles where the queen or princess is a minor or her adult age cannot be established are skipped and listed in dropped.

records.title: Rasputin and the Empress
records.provenance: Royal-hypnosis loose-fit pass, 30 Sep 2026 PT (adults only; leftover and rejected royal leads added as loose fit)
records.already_married_note: Princess Natasha (Diana Wynyard) is engaged to Prince Paul Chegodieff at first and married to him by 1914 (AFI), before Rasputin puts her in a deep trance to stop her going to the Empress
records.evidence: single source — Wikipedia for the trance scene; AFI confirms her identity and marriage, and TV Tropes confirms Rasputin's hypnosis at court
records.fit_note: Loose fit: Natasha is a princess but a lady-in-waiting, not the Empress, and he entrances her to protect his power at court rather than to marry her or take the throne. Low confidence for the trance detail (one source)

records.source_conflict: Royal status: princess betrothed to the emperor (English Wikipedia, TMDB) vs. empress (Chinese Wikipedia)
